name: St. Jakob in Defereggen
kurzbeschreibung: Charming main town of the Defereggental, featuring a beautiful church and a summer sledging run.
beschreibung:
St. Jakob in Defereggen lies at an elevation of 1,050 m in the remotest corner of the Defereggental in Osttirol, surrounded by the foothills of the Hohen Tauern and the Villgratner Berge. With around 850 inhabitants, the main village of the valley is also its political and cultural center, part of one of the most sparsely populated regions of Tirol.

What makes St. Jakob special is the combination of unspoiled character and family friendliness. While many valleys in Tirol have long been shaped by mass tourism, the Defereggental has preserved its quiet character – no large ski resort network, no oversized infrastructure. In return, there is a well-maintained summer toboggan run that starts right at the entrance to the village and is popular with families, as well as an extensive network of hiking trails that leads to the mountain huts of the Rieserfernergruppe and up to the Staller Sattel – a border pass to Südtirol that Goethe already crossed on his journey to Italy. The Parish Church of St. Jakob, a late Baroque building with a tall tower, defines the village's appearance and is considered one of the most beautiful village churches in Osttirol.
